root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence does not establish an independent root-level semantic principle. It chiefly documents the dual expression كِلَا and its feminine counterpart كِلْتَا.
root_idea.development: The lexical discussion treats كِلَا as singular in form but dual in meaning, with كِلْتَا used for the feminine counterpart; no broader semantic development is supplied.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested masculine dual pronoun/determiner form.

senses.definition: The masculine dual pronoun or determiner: both of the two.
senses.usage_conditions: Singular in form but dual in meaning. When annexed to an explicit noun, its alif remains; when annexed to a pronoun, it is inflected, as in كِلَاهُمَا and كِلَيْهِمَا. The supplied Quran occurrence is the attached-pronoun form كِلَاهُمَا.

senses.definition: The feminine dual pronoun or determiner: both of two feminine entities.
senses.usage_conditions: The feminine counterpart of كِلَا. It is used with a feminine dual referent; the supplied Quran occurrence is annexed to the explicit noun الْجَنَّتَيْنِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A term for feathers of the kind so designated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic lexical noun; the supplied evidence gives a cross-reference for further clarification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for two stars on the ear of Taurus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual astronomical name, also referred to by the name الكَلْبَانِ in the supplied entry.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Paradigmatic forms followed by a pointer to كَلَأَ; no lexical definition is supplied.
The unit gives the lexical meaning of a term for feathers.
The unit gives the astronomical name for two stars on Taurus.

cautions: The unvocalized spelling كلا is ambiguous. The supplied Mufradat entry for كَلَّا concerns a particle of repudiation or rebuke, not the Quranic nominal forms كِلَا and كِلْتَا, so it is not assigned to either public form.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Mufradat row 1266 discusses the distinct particle كَلَّا and has no corresponding supplied QAC form group; it is therefore excluded from the lexical senses of this root artifact.
